Un travail en parallèle est donc possible mais seulement les week-ends ou soirées.'
fitNotes: Prestige route into French film sound, and the international concours is designed for exactly his nationality profile — but it is a four-year, French-language, cinema-centred commitment costing €32,000 in tuition alone, with roughly 7 admitted per year across all departments. It does not serve a DJ/producer goal: there is no music-production, mixing-for-records or electronic-music track. Realistically a stretch/self-pay fallback, not a primary target, unless the French Embassy in Tunis funds him.

program: Formation supérieure Musique Son Image — mention SON (FSMSI mention Son), 2e cycle / intégration post-licence
university: Conservatoire national supérieur de musique et de danse de Paris (CNSMDP)
degree: Diplôme de 2e cycle supérieur de Musicien-ingénieur du Son valant grade de Master
durationEcts: 2 years / 120 ECTS (Cycle 2 only; the full FSMSI path is 4 years / 240 ECTS including Cycle 1)
focus: Music Production + Recording/Engineering + Immersive/Spatial Audio + Sound Design (option) + live sound
institutionType: Public conservatoire national supérieur (Ministère de la Culture), member of Université PSL
language: French (interviews are held in French); an 'Anglais : métiers de l'audiovisuel' module is compulsory
whatYouStudy: Two individualised years with a chosen professional specialisation among PRODUCTION MUSICALE, SPECTACLE VIVANT or CRÉATION, under personal tutors. Compulsory modules with ECTS: Technologie audio (12), Projets de production / 'Book' (24), Projet de recherche (22), Prise de son classique (9), Prise de son jazz et musiques actuelles (9), Mixage musiques actuelles (9), Mixage musique acoustique (9), Travaux pratiques FSMSI, Communication et gestion de projet (4), Stage FSMSI (20), plus law/regulation and live-performance safety modules. Optional 5-ECTS modules include Design sonore, Mastering, 'Réalisation et mixage en musiques actuelles', 'Vidéo 360, Audio 3D, nouveaux médias', 'Réalisation en informatique musicale : développement, création, répertoire', Direction artistique, Sonorisation, Son à l'image, Arrangement (chanson ou jazz), Création/composition/production pour la musique à l'image. Compulsory two-month placement with the Conservatoire's audiovisual department; research themes include Audio 3D, spatialisation for live performance, augmented reality, 360 video. Optional joint Licence Musique et Musicologie with Sorbonne Université.
entryRequirements: 'No age limit for this competition.' Prerequisites as published for the 2026-2027 entry: 'BAC+3 diploma (European bachelor's degree or bachelor's degree from a scientific, technical or audiovisual training course) or international equivalent' AND 'D.E.M level from a Conservatoire for music. Applicants must have a very good knowledge of music theory, a sound musical culture, a knowledge of composition (harmony and/or counterpoint) and musical analysis.' French: candidates admitted to the 2nd cycle who are not nationals of francophone countries must present CEFR B1 before 30 June preceding first enrolment and B2 before 10 December following first enrolment.
portfolioSpec: Eligibility stage: 'Review of each candidate's project portfolio, CV and covering letter. Candidates will be required to submit 3 personal musical, sound or audiovisual projects demonstrating a degree of originality or creativity, or simply showing a certain level of technical mastery. The projects are free and may take any form: score, recorded music, model, sound recording, sound fiction, soundtrack for images, film music, sound design, video creation, audiovisual music clip, short film, video sequence of filmed music, etc.' Each project must carry an explanatory note on artistic aims, choices, constraints, locations and tools used plus an assessment of the result, stating what the candidate personally implemented — 'This note must be concise and may not under no circumstances exceed 3 pages.' Projects uploaded to the registration platform by midnight on 24 May 2026.
auditionSpec: Jury pre-selection of applications 4 May 2026; eligibility selection 1 June 2026. Admission tests, all on site: oral test in musical training (16 June 2026); oral test in sciences (17 June 2026); critical listening test on recordings OR comparative analysis test on films/videos/film-repertoire extracts (17 June 2026); interviews in French with the jury on the submitted personal projects and professional experience (18-19 June 2026). Roughly 8 places per year at FSMS level (per Onisep) — UNVERIFIED against the school's own page.
acceptsNonMusic: PARTLY — CHECK. The bachelor requirement explicitly welcomes a non-music degree: 'European bachelor's degree or bachelor's degree from a scientific, technical or audiovisual training course'. A software-engineering BSc satisfies this literally. HOWEVER the same prerequisite block demands 'D.E.M level from a Conservatoire for music' and 'a very good knowledge of music theory, a sound musical culture, a knowledge of composition (harmony and/or counterpoint) and musical analysis', and there is an oral test in musical training. Without conservatoire-level musicianship this is the hard blocker, not the degree.
applicationOpens: PRIOR CYCLE - confirm new date: registration for the 2026-2027 entry opened 12 January 2026.
deadline: PRIOR CYCLE - confirm new date. 2026-2027 entry: application to be completed online by 13 April 2026; projects uploaded by midnight 24 May 2026; pre-selection 4 May 2026; eligibility 1 June 2026; tests 16-19 June 2026.
tuitionIntl: UNVERIFIED — no fee figure on the pages read. CNSMDP is a public Ministry of Culture establishment with low annual droits de scolarité (order of a few hundred euros) but this was not confirmed on an official page. CVEC applies.
fundingLevel: UNVERIFIED (likely low-fee public; no stipend found)
scholarship: The Conservatoire has a 'Bourses et aides' section (seen in site navigation) but its content was not read — UNVERIFIED. None found specifically for non-EU candidates.
facilities: 'L'enjeu de cette formation, originale et sans équivalent en France' — trains 'musicien·nes-réalisateur·trices'. Access to the Conservatoire's centre audiovisuel and to the whole musical life of the institution (orchestras, ensembles, jazz and musiques actuelles departments) as recording material. Research partnerships on Audio 3D, spatialisation for live performance, augmented reality and 360 video. Sorbonne Université partnership for a joint musicology licence. Department renamed from 'métiers du son' to 'Musique Son Image'.
fitNotes: Curriculum-wise this is the closest thing in France to a genuine music-production and mixing master: prise de son classique/jazz/musiques actuelles, mixage musiques actuelles, mastering, design sonore, Audio 3D, plus a production 'Book'. It is also nearly free and has NO age limit. The realistic obstacle is severe: DEM-level music theory, harmony/counterpoint, musical analysis and an oral musical-training test. Without several years of formal music training he will not clear the admission tests, however strong his engineering background. Worth a long-shot application only if he spends 2026 doing serious formation musicale.

whatYouStudy: 'La pratique de l'électroacoustique est envisagée comme discipline principale.' The name is deliberately open 'afin de pouvoir accueillir toutes les formes de projets, d'usages et de visées dans le domaine des musiques électroniques, qu'elles soient accompagnées ou non d'images, de vidéo, de mise en scène ou de lumières.' Studies are defined 'en termes de pratique quotidienne (aux contacts du studio et de ses machines)'; there is 'pas de parcours étudiant·e « type » ou prédéfini ; les projets compositionnels individuels sont le support même des études'. Structure: UE1 discipline principale; UE2 associated knowledge + one complementary discipline linked to the master research project; UE3 transversal (language, professional-insertion placements, research methodology, master's mémoire); UE4 disciplines d'ouverture from over a hundred options. Annual participation in the Empreintes creation festival; collaborations with ENSBAL and ENSATT, Mannheim and symphonic orchestra formats, an improvisation collective; principal teacher François Roux, plus Michele Tadini in the electroacoustic class.
entryRequirements: External candidates: 'Peuvent se présenter au concours d'entrée en 2e cycle du CNSMD de Lyon, les étudiants titulaires d'un DNSPM ou d'un diplôme valant grade de Licence (Bachelor) DANS LA DISCIPLINE CONCERNÉE, délivré par un établissement d'enseignement supérieur français ou étranger.' 'L'admissibilité se fait sur dossier.' Age: 'Le candidat devra être âgé de 16 à 30 ans.' No candidate may sit the entrance concours in the same discipline more than three times (a fourth attempt is granted to anyone who has been admissible at least once). Studies are full-time with compulsory attendance.
portfolioSpec: Admissibility is on dossier, submitted entirely online via the CNSMD 'Cadence' platform, with a required 'Fiche projet de recherche — Master' form, a 'Déclaration sur l'honneur 2e cycle' and a 'Parenté et authenticité des œuvres' declaration; video recommendations are published as a separate document. Exact number, length and format of the works to submit for composition électroacoustique: NOT published outside the yearly 'programme des épreuves', which 'sont publiés le jour de l'ouverture des inscriptions' — UNVERIFIED.
auditionSpec: Concours d'entrée in two stages: admissibility on dossier, then on-site admission tests whose programme is released only when registration opens. Exact test format for électroacoustique UNVERIFIED. Annales for the 2025 concours are downloadable from the school site.
acceptsNonMusic: NO / very unlikely — the wording is restrictive: a licence-grade degree is required 'dans la discipline concernée'. A BSc in software engineering is not a degree in electroacoustic composition, so a Tunisian CS graduate would almost certainly be ruled inadmissible on dossier. He would first need a DNSPM, a licence in music, or a DEM-level electroacoustic qualification. CHECK directly with the concours office before investing.
applicationOpens: PRIOR CYCLE - confirm new date: 'Le calendrier des concours ... est publié chaque année en NOVEMBRE sur le site du CNSMD Lyon' — so the 2027 calendar should appear around November 2026. The 2026 calendar is currently online.
deadline: PRIOR CYCLE - confirm new date — only the 2026 concours calendar is published; no 2027 dates. Registration and document upload are both done on the Cadence platform and no late request is accepted.
tuitionIntl: UNVERIFIED — no fee figure on the pages read (public Ministry of Culture conservatoire; expect low annual droits plus CVEC, but not confirmed).
scholarship: None found. The school has an international-partnership network (90+ institutions) and Erasmus+ mobility, but no named scholarship for a Tunisian degree-seeking student was found on the pages read.
facilities: Dedicated electroacoustic studio practice ('aux contacts du studio et de ses machines'); Espace Transversal de Création; 11 diplomas accessible from the discipline including an international master (CoPeCo); Empreintes festival and What'Sup festival; cross-disciplinary work with dance, staging and the ENSATT theatre school and ENSBAL art school; possibility to add the Diplôme d'État or Certificat d'aptitude in composition; onward routes to a Doctorat Recherche et Pratique and an Artist Diploma CreationS.
fitNotes: Artistically this is one of the most attractive electronic-music masters in France — individual composition projects, daily studio practice, an explicitly open definition of 'musiques électroniques', and cheap public tuition. The blocking clause is the admission rule requiring a licence-grade degree 'dans la discipline concernée' plus the age cap of 30. For a CS graduate with no conservatoire background this is realistically closed for 2027; a plausible two-step plan would be a French university master in electroacoustic/musical computing first (e.g. Saint-Étienne or Gustave Eiffel), then this.

program: Parcours Conception son (Diplôme Arts et Techniques du Théâtre)
university: École Nationale Supérieure des Arts et Techniques du Théâtre (ENSATT)
degree: Diplôme Arts et Techniques du Théâtre conférant le grade de Master
durationEcts: 3 years full-time, of which one is a preparatory year ('Formation initiale en trois années dont une année préparatoire'), entered at Bac+2 / 120 ECTS. ECTS total UNVERIFIED.
focus: Sound Design for live performance / theatre + Live Electronics + Sound Engineering (régie, ingénierie, création)
institutionType: Public grande école (Ministère de la Culture)
language: French — non-nationals of officially francophone states must supply a DALF C1 (or equivalent TCF/DALF). Tunisia is NOT on the school's exemption list, so a C1 certificate is required.
whatYouStudy: Three years covering physical acoustics, sound technologies and practices, and the aesthetics of artistic projects, training students for 'régie, ingénierie ou création' roles as 'l'interlocuteur privilégié' providing both technical and artistic guidance on a production. A master-level mémoire is written (the prerequisites explicitly ask for 'qualités rédactionnelles (en vue de la rédaction d'un mémoire de niveau Master)'). Cross-disciplinary work with the other nine ENSATT parcours (jeu, mise en scène, scénographie, conception lumière, direction technique, écriture dramatique…) and with CNSMD Lyon. NOTE: the programme page states it is 'en cours de mise à jour' — detailed module list UNVERIFIED.
entryRequirements: Minimum age 18 at 1 September of the entry year, no dérogation. All candidates must hold the baccalauréat (or an equivalence) AND 'justifier d'au moins 2 années d'études supérieures et être détenteurs de 120 crédits ECTS ... délivrés dans le cadre d'une formation reconnue par l'État'. Foreign nationals (except nationals of the listed francophone states — Tunisia is not listed) must provide their most recent diploma translated into French by a sworn translator, plus DALF C1 or an equivalent. Desired knowledge: 'Mathématiques, Physique : niveau minimum requis BAC + 1 scientifique' (published syllabus: integral calculus, linear ODEs, complex numbers and De Moivre, log/exp/power functions, Taylor expansions, derivatives, binary arithmetic and 'notion de programmation algorithmique'; electricity and electromagnetism, mechanics, damped/forced oscillators, resonance, Q factor, travelling and standing waves, interference); writing ability; broad general, literary, contemporary-art and theatre culture; ability to work collectively; any professional experience (placements, personal projects) is desired. Three recommended books: Daniel Deshays 'Pour une écriture du son'; Larrue & Mervant-Roux 'Le son du théâtre XIXe-XXIe siècle'; Yann Paranthoën 'Propos d'un tailleur de sons'.
portfolioSpec: Admissibilité 1 = 'Dossier de recherche : projet de réalisation sonore sur un thème donné'. The 2026 brief: 'Vous réaliserez, à partir de sons que vous aurez enregistrés vous-même, une courte séquence sans musique ni parole ni texte dont le sujet sera (au choix) : le portrait sonore d'un espace naturel que vous avez visité (mer, forêt, lac, montagne...) OU le portrait sonore d'une promenade nocturne que vous avez effectuée' — the sequence must remain comprehensible to the listener. Deliverables: (1) a sound document not exceeding 3 minutes in WAV or AIFF ('format compressé refusé'), where 'la réalisation sera structurée par la prise de son, le montage et le mixage effectués avec les moyens dont dispose le/la candidat(e), MÊME RUDIMENTAIRES'; (2) a PDF text justifying the reflection, conception and realisation, not exceeding 6 typed A4 pages. Both uploaded via francetransfert.numerique.gouv.fr to concours@ensatt.fr, files named CONCOURS_NAME_INITIAL_REGISTRATIONNUMBER.
auditionSpec: Admissibilité 2 (on site at ENSATT, Lyon): a written physics paper (2h00, coefficient 1) and a written paper analysing texts and/or audiovisual documents (1h30, coefficient 1). Admission: an interview with the jury on the CV, motivations and the earlier tests (about 20 minutes). Maximum 6 places ('Nombre de places maximum : 6'). A candidature-review commission first decides who is authorised to compete at all.
acceptsNonMusic: YES — no music or audio diploma is required, and the desired knowledge is explicitly scientific ('Mathématiques, Physique : niveau minimum requis BAC + 1 scientifique', including 'notion de programmation algorithmique'). A software-engineering BSc over-satisfies the 120-ECTS and maths/physics prerequisites. The real filters are the self-recorded 3-minute sound portrait, the theatre/contemporary-art culture expected, and the DALF C1.
applicationOpens: 2027 CYCLE PUBLISHED: online registration 5 January 2027 to 27 February 2027 (registration fee €95). (For comparison, 2026 cycle: 6 Jan 2026 12:00 to 3 Feb 2026 12:00, fee €75.)
deadline: 2027 CYCLE DATES ALREADY PUBLISHED for the Conception son parcours — the strongest calendar certainty in this slice: candidature commission 11 February 2027; 'date limite dossier artistique' 2 March 2027; jury d'admissibilité 1 on 18 March 2027; admissibilité 2 on 7 April 2027; entretiens 8 April 2027. Confirm on ensatt.fr/concours as the fiche concours 2027 is released.
tuitionIntl: €605 total for 2026/2027 (€500 droits de scolarité + €105 CVEC). Concours registration fee €95 for 2027 (€75 in 2026). No differentiated non-EU fee published.
fundingLevel: Partial (very low public fees; no stipend)
scholarship: None found on the pages read. ENSATT is a public Ministry of Culture school; bourse sur critères sociaux may apply if eligible — UNVERIFIED for a non-EU candidate.
stipend: No stipend found. Lyon living costs at own expense.
facilities: France's national theatre arts-and-techniques school; ten parcours trained together on shared productions, so the sound designer works with directors, scenographers, lighting designers and actors on real stagings. Collaboration links with CNSMD Lyon. Detailed studio/equipment inventory UNVERIFIED (page under revision).
fitNotes: The most actionable target in this slice right now: the 2027 concours calendar is already published, fees are €605/year, entry needs only 120 ECTS plus Bac+1-level maths/physics — which his degree covers outright — and the portfolio brief is explicitly forgiving about equipment ('même rudimentaires'). Two real obstacles: DALF C1 must be obtained (he is fluent, so achievable, but it must be certified and booked early), and only 6 places exist. The mismatch is content: this is theatre and live-performance sound design, not club music production — he would emerge a superb sound designer/live-sound engineer, with electronic-music production as a side benefit rather than the core.

program: DNSEP Design mention Design sonore (years 4 and 5)
university: École supérieure d'art et de design TALM — site du Mans (ESAD TALM-Le Mans), with IRCAM, ENSCI-Les Ateliers and Le Mans Université / LAUM
degree: DNSEP (Diplôme National Supérieur d'Expression Plastique) conférant le grade de master
durationEcts: 2 years (années 4 and 5, semesters 7-10). ECTS total UNVERIFIED (French DNSEP = 120 ECTS at 2nd cycle).
focus: Sound Design (industrial, object, environmental, multimodal) + Sonic Arts + some Immersive/Spatial Audio
institutionType: Public art and design school (école supérieure d'art), in partnership with a research institute (IRCAM), a design school (ENSCI) and a university acoustics lab (LAUM/CNRS)
language: French (a compulsory 'Anglais, le langage comme matière, matériau et matériel' module in UE3)
whatYouStudy: Semesters 7 and 9 modules: 'Création sonore appliquée', 'Workshop applicatif', 'Production, diffusion et perception du son, appliquées au design sonore', 'Informatique sonore et technique son', 'Workshop arduino', 'Méthodologie créative en design sonore', 'Atelier Radio', 'Éléments scientifiques', 'Concepts de design et cognition auditive appliqués au design sonore', 'Histoire et théorie du sonore', 'Ateliers de recherche et création (ARC)', 'Anthropocène : usage et mésusage du monde', histoire des arts, pratique professionnelle, pré-mémoire then mémoire. Semester 8 is international exchange or a company placement. Semester 10 = mémoire and plastic-work defence before a jury of professionals. The year opens with a two-week 'workshop applicatif' answering a real brief from an industrial or institutional partner, in mixed teams with ENSCI design students — past clients: Décathlon, SETRAM/Le Mans Métropole tram sonification, Groupe PSA (gestural and sound interfaces), SNCF Direction Innovation, Maison de la Radio / Radio France, RATP, GHT Psychiatrie Sainte-Anne. Students also run '24 heures' of radio on the school station Radio-on and produce work for Le Mans Sonore, the city's international sound biennial.
entryRequirements: 'Ce DNSEP s'adresse à tout type de créat.eurs.rices sonores, designers, musicien.ne.s, composit.eurs.rices, artistes, dont la pratique sonore et musicale peut s'adapter aux champs d'application très divers du design sonore.' Accepted profiles: 'Le.la candidat.e peut être diplômé.e d'une filière artistique ou d'électroacoustique des universités (ou être inscrit.e en licence au moment du concours - titre RNCP niveau II -) ; d'une école d'art ou de design équivalent au niveau licence (DNA ou équivalents étrangers) ; d'une école d'enseignement musical spécialisé équivalent au niveau licence (DNSPM ou équivalents étrangers), d'un DEM de composition ou électroacoustique d'un établissement musical spécialisé agréé par l'État, à condition de posséder en plus une licence scientifique ou en sciences humaines.' Selection criteria: 'La motivation, l'ouverture d'esprit, la faculté d'adaptation à des contextes spécifiques, le potentiel à travailler en équipe'. About ten places ('accessible à une dizaine de jeunes diplômé.e.s').
portfolioSpec: Two-stage commission. 'La phase de pré-sélection se déroule sans la présence du.de la candidat.e et comporte une seule épreuve : l'évaluation du dossier personnel de candidature par la commission d'admissibilité — composée du directeur de TALM-Le Mans et d'au moins trois intervenant.e.s de la mention Design sonore — avec un examen approfondi des éléments fournis'. The jury reads 'votre portfolio envoyé pour la présélection'. The exact number of works, durations and file formats are NOT specified in the official presentation document — UNVERIFIED; request the current concours notice from contact-lemans@talm.fr.
auditionSpec: 'La phase d'admission' — admissible candidates present a personal dossier before a jury which has already read the portfolio; 'les membres de la commission évaluent la motivation du.de la candidat.e, son goût pour la création, sa curiosité intellectuelle, sa capacité à être en prise avec les enjeux contemporains, ainsi que sa capacité à développer une réflexion et une pratique personnelle.' On-site interview at Le Mans. Dates for the 2027 entry UNVERIFIED.
acceptsNonMusic: CHECK — probably not on its own. The published list of accepted diplomas is art, design, university electroacoustic/artistic filières, DNSPM or a DEM in composition/electroacoustics. A scientific licence appears only as an ADDITIONAL condition attached to the DEM route ('à condition de posséder en plus une licence scientifique ou en sciences humaines'), not as a standalone qualification. A software-engineering BSc with no artistic or electroacoustic credential is therefore not clearly eligible; the school does, however, open the programme to 'tout type de créateurs sonores ... dont la pratique sonore et musicale peut s'adapter'. Ask the school in writing before applying.
applicationOpens: UNVERIFIED — no 2027 concours calendar found on the pages read.
deadline: UNVERIFIED — no published date for the 2027 entry. (The public art-school concours cycle in France typically runs January-May.) Contact contact-lemans@talm.fr / 02 72 16 48 78.
tuitionIntl: UNVERIFIED — no figure on the documents read. Public écoles supérieures d'art typically charge several hundred euros per year plus CVEC, but the differentiated non-EU regime for écoles d'art was not confirmed.
scholarship: None found in the official presentation document.
facilities: 'Studio son, équipé d'une écoute en 5.1'; multitrack digital recorders, an ambisonic microphone, an octophonic diffusion system, assorted microphones, audio interfaces, amplifiers and loudspeakers; MIDI controllers and a radio studio; plus full art-school workshops (volume, photography, video, engraving and print, painting, casting, mechatronics). Partners: IRCAM (Labo STMS and Perception & Design Sonores team — Nicolas Misdariis, Patrick Susini), ENSCI-Les Ateliers Paris (Roland Cahen, sound studio), Le Mans Université's LAUM (CNRS). Teaching team: Olivier Houix (IRCAM researcher, coordinator), Rodolphe Alexis, Fabien Bourdier, Ludovic Germain (ENSCI graduate, founder of the LAPS sound-design agency). Host of Le Mans Sonore biennial.
fitNotes: Exceptional industry exposure — real briefs from SNCF, RATP, PSA, Radio France — and the IRCAM/ENSCI/LAUM triangle is unique in Europe. But the discipline is FUNCTIONAL sound design (product, transport, museum, UX signage), not music production, and the admissions list is built around art/design/electroacoustic diplomas. For a CS graduate aiming at DJ/producer work this is both a fit mismatch and an eligibility risk; it would suit him far better if he first built an art/sound portfolio and if the school confirms in writing that a scientific licence plus a strong sound portfolio is admissible.

program: Master Acoustique et musicologie — parcours Ingénierie et conception sonore
university: Aix-Marseille Université (AMU), Faculté des Sciences / UFR ALLSH
city: Marseille (campus Saint-Charles), with some sessions in Aix-en-Provence
durationEcts: 2 years / 4 semesters / 120 ECTS (30 per semester)
focus: Sound Design + Immersive/Spatial Audio + Recording/Engineering, with a strong acoustics and signal-processing spine
institutionType: Public university
language: French (C1 minimum for non-French speakers); English B2 minimum required
whatYouStudy: Semester 1 is a common core with the musicology side, then specialisation into Ingénierie et conception sonore from semester 2. Modules: physical acoustics and signal processing; perception and cognition; computer programming and software development; sound and music listening practices; collective projects and field schools; compulsory 5-month internship in semester 4.
entryRequirements: Selection on dossier via monmaster.gouv.fr. 'Licences conseillées: Physique, sciences et technologies, mathématiques, informatique, mécanique, MPCI (Mathématiques, physique, chimie, informatique), sciences pour l'ingénieur.' Language: French C1 minimum for non-French speakers, English B2 minimum. Capacity UNVERIFIED.
portfolioSpec: No portfolio requirement published on the programme page — selection is on academic dossier (transcripts, motivation) through monmaster.gouv.fr. UNVERIFIED whether a personal project or sound works may be attached; check the mention's 'critères d'examen des candidatures' on monmaster when the 2027 campaign opens.
auditionSpec: None published — no live audition, no on-site test mentioned. Selection appears to be dossier-only. UNVERIFIED whether an interview is used.
acceptsNonMusic: YES, explicitly and unusually favourably. The recommended bachelor list names 'informatique' and 'sciences pour l'ingénieur' directly, and the syllabus assumes programming ability. This is one of the few French sound masters where a software-engineering BSc is the INTENDED entry profile rather than an exception.
applicationOpens: PRIOR CYCLE - confirm new date: national monmaster.gouv.fr campaign for M1 typically opens late February. The programme page's indicative timeline shows applications March-April, review April-June, admission June-July (2023 cycle shown).
deadline: PRIOR CYCLE - confirm new date — the page shows only an old indicative March-April window. The 2027 deadline will be set by the national monmaster.gouv.fr calendar (published each winter).
tuitionIntl: Standard national master fee applies to exempted students (~€250-260/yr) but non-EU 'droits différenciés' of about €3,950/yr for a master in 2026-2027 may apply unless AMU grants an exemption. AMU's own exemption policy was NOT read — UNVERIFIED. Plus CVEC (~€105).
fundingLevel: Partial to full depending on the differentiated-fee exemption (which is a university-level decision, capped nationally at 30% of affected students in 2026-2027 and 25% in 2027-2028).
scholarship: None programme-specific found. Realistic vehicles: France Excellence Eiffel (€1,181/month at master level, age limit 25 for master, nominated BY the institution — the 2026 call closed 8 January 2026, so the 2027 call will likely close early January 2027); Campus France Tunisie / French Embassy bourses; AMU international scholarships UNVERIFIED.
stipend: No programme stipend. Eiffel, if awarded via the university, pays €1,181/month plus air ticket and social cover.
facilities: AMU acoustics and musicology environment, Saint-Charles campus in central Marseille; field schools and collective projects; 5-month industry internship. Studio/console inventory UNVERIFIED.
fitNotes: The best 'front door' in France for exactly his degree: the programme asks for a physics/maths/informatique licence, is dossier-only (no live audition, no music theory test), costs public-university money, and is in a major city. The caveat is orientation — the mention is 'Acoustique et musicologie', so expect a heavier scientific and perceptual load (signal processing, cognition, acoustics) than hands-on beat-making; production craft will come from the projects and the internship rather than from a mixing studio curriculum. Strong first-choice candidate, but he should pair it with a portfolio of his own tracks to argue the creative side, and check the differentiated-fee exemption early.

program: Master Cinéma et Audiovisuel — parcours Ingénierie du son à l'image (département SATIS)
university: Aix-Marseille Université — Faculté des Sciences, département SATIS
durationEcts: 2 years (M1 + M2); entry requires 180 ECTS for M1, 240 ECTS for M2. Programme ECTS UNVERIFIED (French master = 120 ECTS).
focus: Film/Game Sound + Recording/Engineering (son à l'image, multichannel mixing, live capture)
institutionType: Public university film school (described as France's fourth public higher film school)
language: French — C1 level required for international students
whatYouStudy: Production-driven curriculum on professional equipment in professional configurations. M1: 5 fiction shorts shot on Super 16mm, 5 documentaries, multicamera capture work. M2: 2 fiction shorts (15 min, HD, multichannel mix), 1 cine-concert, 1 documentary (26 min, HD). Plus a placement of 6 months or more. SATIS teaches five specialities side by side — image, sound, music, editing, production/directing — so sound students work inside real crews.
entryRequirements: M1 entry: 'Licence, 180 ECTS et 4 semaines de stage dans le secteur'. Candidates 'doivent avoir un projet professionnel (appuyé par une première expérience professionnelle d'au moins un mois dans le domaine de l'audiovisuel : convention de stage et rapport d'activité) et une forte motivation'. M2 entry: M1 Cinéma/Audiovisuel, 240 ECTS, 8 weeks of prior sector experience. French C1 for international students.
portfolioSpec: No creative portfolio of finished works is specified. Instead the decisive documents are the professional project statement plus PROOF of at least one month of audiovisual-sector experience (internship agreement + activity report) and 4 weeks of sector internship. UNVERIFIED whether personal sound works may be attached.
auditionSpec: 'Le recrutement se fait sur dossier, QCM et entretien' — application file, a multiple-choice test and an interview. No instrumental audition. Test content and location UNVERIFIED (likely on site in Aubagne).
acceptsNonMusic: YES on the diploma (any 'Licence, 180 ECTS' is the stated requirement — no music or audiovisual degree named), BUT there is a hard non-academic condition a fresh CS graduate will fail today: four weeks of sector internship plus at least one month of documented professional experience in audiovisual, with an internship agreement and activity report. He would need to arrange an audio/audiovisual internship in 2026 to be eligible at all.
applicationOpens: PRIOR CYCLE - confirm new date. Pre-registration deadline is stated as 'early April'; contact sciences-satis-scol@univ-amu.fr. Platform for M1 is expected to be monmaster.gouv.fr — UNVERIFIED for this parcours.
deadline: PRIOR CYCLE - confirm new date: 'pre-registration deadline is early April' with no year specified on the page read. Confirm the 2027 date with the SATIS scolarité (Florence Tildach, sciences-satis-scol@univ-amu.fr, 04 12 23 10 48, 9 boulevard Lakanal, 13400 Aubagne).
tuitionIntl: Public university fees; non-EU 'droits différenciés' of ~€3,950/yr for master in 2026-2027 may apply unless exempted (AMU policy UNVERIFIED). Plus CVEC.
fundingLevel: Partial to full depending on differentiated-fee exemption; no stipend.
scholarship: None programme-specific found. Same external routes as any French public master: France Excellence Eiffel (institution-nominated, €1,181/month, master age limit 25), Campus France Tunisie / Embassy bourses.
facilities: Purpose-built public film school in Aubagne (near Marseille); Super 16mm film shooting, multichannel/HD post, cine-concert production, multicamera live capture; five co-located specialities create genuine crew experience. Console/studio inventory UNVERIFIED.
fitNotes: Excellent hands-on volume — around a dozen real productions across two years — and a licence in any field is formally acceptable. Two frictions: the mandatory documented audiovisual work experience before applying (a 2026 to-do, not a 2027 one), and the film-and-television orientation, which trains a boom operator/re-recording mixer rather than a music producer. Good backup if he can land an audio internship in Tunisia or France during 2026; weak fit for the DJ goal.

program: Master Cinéma et audiovisuel — parcours Son (ENSAV)
university: Université Toulouse - Jean Jaurès / École Nationale Supérieure d'AudioVisuel (ENSAV, formerly ESAV)
durationEcts: 2 years (M1 + M2). ECTS for the programme UNVERIFIED; M1 entry requires 180 ECTS, M2 entry 240 ECTS.
focus: Film Sound + Sound Design + Recording (practice-based, very production-heavy)
institutionType: Public university film school (école interne of Université Toulouse - Jean Jaurès)
whatYouStudy: Roughly 15 compulsory exercises over the two years — sound pieces, documentaries and fiction works, each with defined pedagogical constraints — plus a personal film at the end of M1 and of M2 with no restriction on genre or duration, each accompanied by a methodological dissertation. Taught content covers acoustic principles, analogue and digital audio technology, sound recording, mixing and distribution/diffusion techniques.

portfolioSpec: The dossier de candidature is a downloadable ENSAV form ('Dossier-M1-2026-2027.pdf'). Request the son-specific dossier from ensav@univ-tlse2.fr.
auditionSpec: Selection on dossier, with a possible interview after the file review ('un entretien peut être programmé'). No live audition or written concours found. UNVERIFIED whether the interview is remote or on site.
acceptsNonMusic: YES, and this is the clearest positive wording found anywhere in this slice: the accepted bachelor list explicitly includes 'DE L'INFORMATIQUE'. A Bac+3 in computer science is a named, accepted entry qualification. No music degree, no audition, no music-theory test.
applicationOpens: PRIOR CYCLE - confirm new date: the ENSAV M1 dossier for 2026-2027 was posted in March 2026.
deadline: PRIOR CYCLE - confirm new date. 2026-2027 cycle: dossiers due 10 May 2026 (M2 REX: 31 August 2026); the M1 Production route on Mon Master closed 16 March 2026. Confirm the 2027-2028 son deadline with ensav@univ-tlse2.fr.
tuitionIntl: Public university fees; non-EU 'droits différenciés' of ~€3,950/yr for master in 2026-2027 may apply unless exempted (Toulouse Jean Jaurès policy UNVERIFIED). Plus CVEC. Not stated on the programme page — UNVERIFIED.
fundingLevel: Partial to full depending on differentiated-fee exemption; no stipend.

program: Master Ingénierie de l'image, ingénierie du son — parcours Image et Son (ISB)

degree: Master (mention Ingénierie de l'image, ingénierie du son)

institutionType: Public university (science faculty), engineering-oriented sound and image school

Total school enrolment about 50 students; the school reports 100% professional insertion 18 months after the M2.
portfolioSpec: No portfolio of works specified — selection is 'examen du dossier de candidature et entretien'. Whether personal sound work can be attached is UNVERIFIED; the school's own admissions page does not list the dossier contents.
auditionSpec: No audition. An interview ('entretien') follows the dossier review for both M1 and M2. Format and location UNVERIFIED.

A software-engineering BSc is scientifically adjacent, and the master's own spine is signal processing and electroacoustics, but the page also warns that entry at M1 is unusual because most students come up through the in-house L3. applicationOpens: PRIOR CYCLE - confirm new date: M1 applications for 2026-2027 opened 17 February 2026 on monmaster; L3 and M2 applications opened 27 April 2026 on eCandidat.

scholarship: None programme-specific found. External: France Excellence Eiffel (institution-nominated), Campus France Tunisie / Embassy bourses.

Worth an early eligibility email; if they accept him, the curriculum-to-goal alignment is among the best in the slice.

program: Erasmus Mundus Joint Master DIGICREA — Digital Creativity, Art & Science, SOUND-MUSIC specialization
university: Consortium: Université Jean Monnet Saint-Étienne (coordinator, France) + Universidade Católica Portuguesa Porto (Portugal) + University of Silesia Katowice/Cieszyn (Poland)
degree: Erasmus Mundus Joint Master — multiple degrees awarded by Université Jean Monnet, Universidade Católica Portuguesa and University of Silesia
durationEcts: 2 years / 4 semesters across three countries, ending with an internship. ECTS total UNVERIFIED (EMJM standard = 120).
focus: Electronic Music / Music Production + Sound Design + digital creation (there is a dedicated SOUND-MUSIC specialization path, distinct from the IMAGE path)
language: English — 'The entire program is taught in English.'
institutionType: Public university consortium (Erasmus Mundus Joint Master, EU-funded)
whatYouStudy: Training in audiovisual new media, emerging technologies in the film industry, music, graphic design, artificial intelligence, virtual reality and their applications. Two specialization paths: SOUND-MUSIC and IMAGE; all candidates apply to one only. The Selection Board 'assesses the candidate's predispositions for professions related to the production of audio-visual and musical forms, including the production of Extended Reality films'. Mobility: Saint-Étienne, then Porto, then Katowice, then an internship with public and private sector partners. The programme shares courses with the Université Jean Monnet Master CCNT (Création Contemporaine et Nouvelles Technologies, RIM/Arts numériques), so the Saint-Étienne semester connects to the RIM music-computing environment. Detailed module list UNVERIFIED.
entryRequirements: 'A Bachelor's degree of at least 180 ECTS is the minimum requirement to enrol' — no field restriction stated. Candidates with at least 150 ECTS at application may be considered with a sworn statement that 180 ECTS will be obtained before the start. Documents: EUROPASS CV in English; proof of nationality; certified copies (with certified English translations) of higher-education and high-school diplomas and full transcripts; at least two letters of recommendation in English on letterhead, signed and stamped, with referee contacts; a 'Science qualification and experience in New Technology' form in which candidates 'describe their level in mathematics, digital signal processing, and computer science ... their skills and level in JavaScript, Python or C, HTML, real-time graphics programming, geometry, trigonometric functions, and algebra courses'; English certificate at minimum B2, C1 recommended (IELTS 6, TOEFL iBT ≥90, TOEFL ITP 550, TOEIC ≥650, or a degree taught 100% in English with a university letter). Applications via the UJM eCandidat portal — explicitly NOT via Études en France.
portfolioSpec: 'Artistic or Professional Portfolio: Document presenting artistic productions related to the DIGICREA curriculum and specialization path chosen by the applicant. All projects included in the portfolio must not be more than 5 years old. Submit EXACTLY 3 TO 5 specific works or project (video/audio/images) including metadata (title, short description, public link, and their role): minimum 3 works - maximum 5 works. Please number works presented in the portfolio from 1 to 5.' For Sound-Music applicants 'it can be a composition project (orchestral or electronic), sound design project, sound concept project, music piece cycle, demo, etc.' The PDF is capped at 5 MB, so online links are used for the media. Also required in place of a cover letter: a VIDEO PRESENTATION of maximum 2 minutes covering, in order, current situation, motivation for applying, understanding of the programme, why the candidate can succeed, and ideas for applied research and professional development — link supplied in a PDF 'Motivation letter' item, accessible to anyone with the link until mid-April.
auditionSpec: Stage II: shortlisted applicants only, an ONLINE 15-minute interview (2026 cycle: forecast 24-30 March 2026) assessing 'the candidate's personality characteristics, way of thinking, personal life experience, and character attributes'. Candidates may additionally be asked to attend a videoconference to verify English level. No on-site test, no live audition, no travel needed to apply.
acceptsNonMusic: YES — the strongest case in this slice. The only academic requirement is 'A Bachelor's degree of at least 180 ECTS', with no field restriction, and the application actively rewards a software background: a compulsory form asks the candidate to rate their level in mathematics, digital signal processing and computer science, and specifically in JavaScript, Python or C, HTML, real-time graphics programming, geometry, trigonometry and algebra. A software-engineering graduate with a music portfolio is close to the ideal applicant profile.
applicationOpens: 2027 CYCLE: 'The call for applications for the next DIGICREA cohort 2027-2029 is expected to open in November 2026. Further information regarding this procedure will be available in the autumn. Please note that some requirements will differ from those of the 2026 selection process.'
deadline: 2027 intake not yet fixed. PRIOR CYCLE reference: the 2026-2028 call opened 14 November 2025 and closed 16 February 2026, with Stage II interviews forecast 24-30 March 2026 — expect a comparable mid-February 2027 deadline. Confirm from November 2026.
tuitionIntl: ZERO. 'Students (scholarship holders and non-scholarship holders) are not charged any tuition fees.' Self-funded students must submit a Guarantee of full financial support with a budget simulation, and document their income for the visa.
fundingLevel: Full (for scholarship holders) — the best funding on offer in this slice
scholarship: Erasmus Mundus Joint Master (EMJM) scholarship: 'a grant of 1,400 euros per month, for a total duration of 24 months. The maximum amount per student is therefore 1,400 euros x 24 months = 33,600 euros', awarded for full-time enrolment over the whole course, covering travel, visa, installation and subsistence, paid into the student's own bank account. A limited number per cohort. 'The application for the scholarship is included within the application for the program itself.' Non-scholarship holders can add Erasmus+ KA131/KA171 mobility funds. Special-needs support available for students with long-term impairments.
stipend: €1,400 per month for 24 months (€33,600 total) plus zero tuition, for scholarship holders. This is the only fully funded option identified in the French slice.
facilities: Three-country mobility with a design and digital-creation environment at each site; at Saint-Étienne it shares teaching with the CCNT/RIM programme, which provides a music studio, video studio, multimedia prototyping studio, sensors, interfaces and sound capture/diffusion equipment. Professionals involved in the shared Saint-Étienne teaching include a sound designer at Ubisoft, a developer at Ableton (Berlin) and Cycling'74 (USA), the sound engineer running the FIL venue studios, and researchers from INRIA and GRAME Lyon.
fitNotes: This is the standout recommendation for him: no tuition, €1,400/month for two years, taught in English (so IELTS/TOEFL rather than DALF), a bachelor in ANY field accepted, a Sound-Music specialization, an application that explicitly credits his programming skills, and a fully remote selection process (online 15-min interview only). The 2027-2029 call is expected to open November 2026 — exactly his window. Two things to do now: build a portfolio of 3-5 numbered works (a composition or sound-design project, a demo, a music cycle) with public links and metadata, and book an English test at B2 minimum, C1 preferred. Caveat: the programme is broad digital creativity — AI, XR, graphic design — rather than a dedicated club-music production course, and it is competitive.

program: Master Arts — parcours Création Contemporaine et Nouvelles Technologies (CCNT), option Réalisateur·rice en Informatique Musicale (RIM)
university: Université Jean Monnet Saint-Étienne (UJM), Faculté Arts Lettres Langues — départements Musicologie et Arts plastiques
durationEcts: 2 years (M1 + M2), with placements in both years. ECTS total UNVERIFIED (French master = 120 ECTS; the livret mentions 30-ECTS dispensations in M2).
focus: Electronic Music / Live Electronics + Music Production technology + Sound Design (jeu vidéo, spectacle vivant, cinéma)
institutionType: Public university
language: French, with some courses in English (shared with the EMJM DIGICREA programme: 'Le master ayant un certain nombre de cours communs avec le master international EMJM DIGICREA, les enseignements concernés sont donnés en langue anglaise.')
whatYouStudy: 'Ce master offre ... une articulation forte entre recherche théorique et maîtrise des technologies électroniques et numériques les plus avancées pour la production musicale et artistique.' RIM option: 'la connaissance et la maîtrise des technologies électroniques et numériques' preparing for the Réalisateur en Informatique Musicale profession, at the interface between software developers, music-computing researchers, composers and any company integrating sound. Teaching is shared between the Arts plastiques and Musicologie departments and is delivered in part by international professionals. Max/MSP appears in the module descriptions. Dedicated equipment and production spaces are provided for both years: 'Un parc matériel spécifique (ordinateurs, capteurs, interfaces, outils de prise de vue, de prise de son et de diffusion, etc.), ainsi que des lieux de production dédiés (studio musical, studio de prise de vue, studio de maquettage de dispositifs multimédia...)'. A placement in M1 and in M2. Named career outcomes include 'designer sonore pour le spectacle vivant, le cinéma, le jeu vidéo', 'professeur de MAO', 'développeur en informatique musicale', and work in creation centres (IRCAM, GRM, Centres Nationaux de Création Musicale) and recording studios.
entryRequirements: The 2025-26 livret states only 'CONDITIONS D'ADMISSION — Se référer aux portails monmaster ou ecandidat.' The programme's own RIM page (M2 route) states: entry for 'Master I en musique, en arts numériques, ou équivalents', or any Master 1 with a demonstrated strong level in music or digital-arts practice; professionals may enter via VAE. Candidates are expected to have 'une culture scientifique et une expérience en informatique musicale et/ou en programmation dans le champ des arts numériques'. Cohort: maximum 20 students. Note the ambiguity: the university presents CCNT as a two-year M1+M2 master, while the older RIM site describes an M2-only professional route — confirm which entry point applies for 2027.
portfolioSpec: For the M2 RIM route: a dossier obtained from the secretariat or downloaded from the university site, submitted via eCandidat, plus an 'audio commentary' exercise for RIM candidates (an analysis of a work, for RAN candidates an artwork analysis) 'demonstrating artistic/musical competence'. For M1 entry via monmaster the required documents are UNVERIFIED — check the mention's 'critères d'examen des candidatures' when the 2027 campaign opens.
auditionSpec: An interview with a jury of professionals assessing motivation and career project, plus the audio-commentary exercise described above. No instrumental audition. 2018-cycle indicative dates were: application deadline 31 May, admission exams 8 June, start September — PRIOR CYCLE, not current.
acceptsNonMusic: PARTLY YES — the profile expected is explicitly scientific: 'une culture scientifique et une expérience en informatique musicale et/ou en programmation dans le champ des arts numériques', and the programme accepts 'des étudiants issus d'autres formations ayant validé un Master 1 et pouvant justifier d'un bon niveau en pratique musicale et/ou artistique numérique'. So a computer-science background is welcome in substance. The obstacle is level, not field: the RIM route as documented starts at M2 and therefore assumes an M1 already completed, plus demonstrable music-computing or digital-arts practice. Confirm whether direct M1 entry from a Bac+3 is open for 2027.
applicationOpens: PRIOR CYCLE - confirm new date: M1 via monmaster.gouv.fr on the national calendar (typically opening late February); M2 via UJM eCandidat (2018 reference: closing 31 May).
deadline: PRIOR CYCLE - confirm new date. The only dates found are a 2018 cycle (application 31 May, exams 8 June). Contact christine.chantelot@univ-st-etienne.fr (Faculté ALL, bâtiment G, 33 rue du 11 novembre, 42023 Saint-Étienne, 04 77 42 13 05).
tuitionIntl: Favourable: UJM applies an AUTOMATIC PARTIAL EXEMPTION from differentiated fees to non-EU students enrolling in a national master's diploma, bringing the fee down to the standard national rate (the page cites €255 as the reduced rate for a previously enrolled cohort). The €3,950 figure on that page is quoted for an engineering diploma, not the master. Plus CVEC (~€105). Confirm the 2027-2028 rate.
fundingLevel: Partial-to-full on fees (automatic partial exemption from differentiated fees at UJM); no stipend attached to the programme itself.
scholarship: No programme scholarship found. However UJM coordinates the EMJM DIGICREA (see separate entry), whose €1,400/month scholarship is the funded alternative at the same university. External routes: France Excellence Eiffel (institution-nominated, €1,181/month at master level, age limit 25 for master; 2026 call closed 8 January 2026), Campus France Tunisie.
stipend: None from this programme. UNVERIFIED whether UJM nominates for Eiffel.
facilities: Dedicated music studio, video studio and multimedia prototyping studio; computers, sensors, interfaces, capture and diffusion tools available across both years. Professional teaching staff include Pierre Colomies (sound designer, Ubisoft Montpellier), Emmanuel Jourdan (RIM/developer, Ableton Berlin and Cycling'74), Christophe Lebreton (RIM, LISILOG), Stéphane Letz (GRAME Lyon), Romain Michon (INRIA), Jérémy Lhuillier (sound engineer, head of studios at Le FIL Saint-Étienne), Michele Tadini (electroacoustic class, CNSMD Lyon), Michel Pascal (CNRR Nice). Regional partners include GRAME and AADN Lyon. Also opens onto doctoral study.
fitNotes: Content-wise one of the best matches for a programmer who wants to make electronic music: Max/MSP, music computing, sound design for games and live performance, an Ableton engineer on staff, a real music studio, and Ubisoft/GRAME/INRIA connections — at near-zero fees thanks to UJM's automatic exemption. Two cautions: the documented RIM route starts at M2, so he must confirm whether he can enter M1 directly with a Bac+3, and the shared DIGICREA courses mean strong English is useful. Practical strategy: apply here AND to DIGICREA at the same university, since a DIGICREA place brings the €33,600 scholarship.

program: Master Arts, Lettres et Civilisations — parcours Création musicale et arts sonores (CMAS)
university: Université Gustave Eiffel (formerly Paris-Est Marne-la-Vallée), UFR Lettres, Arts, Création, Technologies (LACT), with INA GRM

degree: Master mention Arts, Lettres et Civilisations

focus: Electroacoustic composition / Sonic Arts / Electronic Music (research-creation), practice-based

language: French; an English module is part of the professionalisation unit

auditionSpec: None published — dossier-based selection. No audition or on-site test found. UNVERIFIED whether an interview is used.
acceptsNonMusic: NO as published — the required bachelor is 'in music or arts', or a conservatory/art-school diploma at L3 level, and 'Pratique musicale ou sonore indispensable'. program: M2 ATIAM — Acoustique, Traitement du signal, Informatique, Appliqués à la Musique
university: Sorbonne Université (Faculté des Sciences et Ingénierie), in collaboration with IRCAM and Télécom Paris
degree: Master 2 (parcours of a Sorbonne Université Sciences et Technologies master; ATIAM is the second year only)
durationEcts: One year (M2): semester 1 = 30 ECTS (5 modules of 6 ECTS), semester 2 = a 5-6 month research internship in a company or laboratory in France or abroad.
focus: Technical — musical acoustics, sound signal processing, computer music. NOT a production or craft degree.
institutionType: Public university consortium with a national research institute (IRCAM) and a grande école (Télécom Paris)
language: French predominantly — 'Un bon niveau de français est conseillé ... car les cours sont en majorité dispensés en français'; 'un bon niveau d'anglais' also required.

auditionSpec: 'Un entretien de motivation' for pre-selected candidates, held at IRCAM. No audition, no practical sound test.
acceptsNonMusic: YES on field — a computer-science or mathematics background is the intended profile ('M1 en informatique ou mathématiques, école d'ingénieur avec spécialité informatique'), and no music degree is required, only 'un intérêt pour la musique'. applicationOpens: 2026-2027 cycle: applications open 26 March 2026 (per the ATIAM candidatures page). For a 2027-2028 entry, expect a comparable spring 2027 window — PRIOR CYCLE, confirm.
